meaning.en: Knowledge is what you know.

examples.en: He has trouble putting his knowledge into practice.

meaning.en: When you omit something, you leave it out or do not do it.

examples.en: I omitted some important information: he is not coming.

meaning.vi: bù lại, đền bù, bù đắp
meaning.en: To offset means to use one thing to cancel out the effect of another thing.

examples.en: Increased wages are offset by higher prices for goods.

meaning.en: To overlap something means to cover a piece of it.

examples.en: The gift on top overlaps the other gift on the bottom.

meaning.en: When something is secondhand, it has been owned by someone else.

examples.en: Her secondhand jeans were a bit faded in the front.

meaning.en: When you have skill at doing a job, you are good at doing it.

examples.en: She worked with great skill and confidence.

meaning.en: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container.

examples.en: To operate the machine, put your coins into the slot.

meaning.vi: cách, thủ đoạn, mưu kế, mẹo
meaning.en: A tactic is a careful plan to achieve something.

examples.en: Sam thought of a good tactic to attract more business.

meaning.en: If something is beneficial, it is good for you.

examples.en: Drinking milk every day is beneficial for your bones.

meaning.en: A birthplace is a place where a person is born or where something started.

examples.en: China is the birthplace of chopsticks.

meaning.vi: sức chứa, dung tích, năng lực, khả năng
meaning.en: The capacity of something is the amount of things that can be put in it.

examples.en: The parking lot has reached its full capacity.

meaning.en: If something is comparative, it is being judged based on something else.

examples.en: The money that John has is comparative to that of most other adults.

meaning.en: If something is comprehensive, it has all the details about something else.

examples.en: The teacher gave us a comprehensive review for the exam.

meaning.vi: bảo tồn, giữ gìn, duy trì
meaning.en: To conserve something is to protect it from being ruined or used completely.

examples.en: The group worked to conserve the beauty of Europe’s national parks.

meaning.en: If something is crucial, it is extremely important to another thing.

examples.en: Clean air is crucial to the survival of humans, plants, and animals.

meaning.en: Cumulative describes an increase by adding one after another.

examples.en: The cumulative snowfall in the area is fifty centimeters per year.

meaning.vi: gửi (tiền, đồ vật...), đặt cọc, ký quỹ
meaning.en: To deposit something is to put it into a place or another thing.

examples.en: I deposited the money into my bank account.

meaning.vi: phân phối, phân phát, phân bổ
meaning.en: To distribute something is to give it to a number of people.

examples.en: The teacher distributed crayons and markers to her students.

meaning.en: The equator is an imaginary line that splits the Earth into north and south.

examples.en: The equator crosses the northern part of South America.

meaning.vi: ở nước ngoài đưa vào, ngoại lai (cây cỏ, từ, mốt)
meaning.en: Exotic describes something unusual because it is from far away.

examples.en: Rebecca tried many exotic foods on her trip to Africa.

meaning.en: If something is federal, it relates to the government of a country.

examples.en: Sometimes federal laws are different from state laws.

meaning.vi: sự hình thành, sự tạo thành
meaning.en: A formation is the way that something is made.

examples.en: The formation of ice happens when water freezes.

meaning.en: The frequency of something is the number of times that it happens.

examples.en: The frequency of rainstorms is very high, especially during the spring.

meaning.en: An objective is a goal or plan that someone has.

examples.en: My objective this week is to finish my homework by 7:30 every night.

meaning.en: Oxygen is a gas that all living things need to breathe.

examples.en: She thinks there is more oxygen in the air in the country than in the city.

meaning.en: A rainforest is a forest that is in a place where it rains very often.

examples.en: The rainforest is home to many animals.

meaning.en: A strategy is a plan for how to do something.

examples.en: The team came up with a strategy to win the game.

meaning.vi: có rừng, có nhiều cây cối
meaning.en: If an area is wooded, it is covered with trees.

examples.en: Jim and Ben decided to go hiking in the wooded area by the river.

meaning.en: Avail is help or benefit.

examples.en: His studying was to no avail because he failed the test.

meaning.en: To define means to clearly state, show, or explain what something is.

examples.en: People define success in many different ways.

meaning.en: To dread is to be afraid of something that could, or is going to, happen.

examples.en: I dread the possibility that I will not get into college.

meaning.vi: nở ra, phồng ra, giãn, mở rộng
meaning.en: To expand is to become bigger in size.

examples.en: A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.

meaning.vi: quy tắc cơ bản; nguyên tắc cơ bản
meaning.en: If something is fundamental, it is a basic part of something.

examples.en: The fundamental rules of basketball are easy.

meaning.en: If something is horrifying, it is frightening and very unpleasant.

examples.en: There was a horrifying car accident today.

meaning.en: If someone is incredulous about something, they do not believe that it is true.

examples.en: She was incredulous that monkeys could ever drive a car.

meaning.vi: phảng phất, nấn ná, kéo dài
meaning.en: To linger is to last for a long time.

examples.en: The smell of fresh cookies lingered in the bakery.

meaning.vi: cơ thể; cơ quan, tổ chức
meaning.en: An organism is a living thing, especially a very small one.

examples.en: We studied the organism under the microscope.

meaning.en: To paraphrase is to make someone else’s writing or speech shorter.

examples.en: The students were asked to paraphrase the story they had just heard.

meaning.en: A plague is a serious disease that quickly spreads to many people.

examples.en: A plague in Europe killed millions of people.

meaning.vi: hiện giờ, hiện nay, bây giờ
meaning.en: If something happens presently, it is happening right now.

examples.en: Presently, our profits are good, but by next year we can do even better.

meaning.en: If something is random, it happens without any pattern or reason.

examples.en: Young children often ask random questions.

meaning.en: A riot is a crowd that reacts to bad news by violently breaking laws.

examples.en: A riot broke out after the candidate lost the election.

meaning.vi: viết chữ nguệch ngoạc, viết cẩu thả, viết vội vàng
meaning.en: To scribble is to write something quickly without caring about how it looks.

examples.en: I scribbled a rough diagram of our plan and gave it to him.

meaning.vi: điện thờ, miếu thờ, nơi linh thiêng
meaning.en: A shrine is a religious building built to honor a person, event, or god.

examples.en: He prayed at the shrine for an hour.

meaning.vi: tình trạng cô đơn, nơi vắng vẻ, nơi tĩnh mịch
meaning.en: Solitude is the state of being totally alone.

examples.en: John lives a life of solitude because he doesn’t get along well with people.

meaning.en: If something is stark, then it is severe or clear in appearance or outline.

examples.en: There is a stark contrast between their test scores.

meaning.vi: gọi đến, mời đến; triệu tập (cuộc họp)
meaning.en: To summon a person is to ask them to come to you.

examples.en: We summoned the doctor as soon as we noticed she was sick.

meaning.vi: trở nên xấu hơn, trở nên tồi hơn, trở nên tệ hơn
meaning.en: To worsen is to get worse.

examples.en: The weather suddenly worsened, and we had to stay inside.

meaning.en: An automobile is a car.

examples.en: The first automobiles were very different from the ones that exist today.

meaning.en: A candidate is a person who is competing to win something such as a job.

examples.en: Alice is the best candidate for the job.

meaning.en: If something is confidential, it must be kept secret.

examples.en: The information from the meeting is confidential.

meaning.en: If something is corporate, it is related to a large business.

examples.en: Tom enjoys working in the corporate world.

meaning.vi: tăng cường, nâng cao, đề cao, làm nổi bật
meaning.en: To enhance something is to make it better.

examples.en: Amy’s blue shirt really enhances the color of her eyes.

meaning.en: An era is a period of time that has something special about it.

examples.en: During the medieval era, knights wore protective armor.

meaning.vi: hướng dẫn, đường lối chỉ đạo (để vạch ra chính sách...)
meaning.en: A guideline is a rule about how to do something.

examples.en: Before they began the project, the teacher gave them some guidelines.

meaning.en: To incorporate is to add something to another thing.

examples.en: I decided to incorporate a new ingredient into my cake recipe.

meaning.vi: tương tác, tác động qua lại
meaning.en: To interact is to talk to or do something with another person.

examples.en: The kids began to interact when the adults left the room.

meaning.vi: khoảng (thời gian, không gian), khoảng cách
meaning.en: An interval is the time between two things happening.

examples.en: Tony rested for brief intervals while he worked in the yard.

meaning.en: If something is mobile, it can be moved easily.

examples.en: Mobile phones are convenient because you can use them anywhere.

meaning.vi: sửa đổi, thay đổi, bổ sung
meaning.en: To modify something is to change it a little bit.

examples.en: I modified my outfit by adding a belt to it.

meaning.en: If two things are parallel, they are the same distance away from each other (along their entire length).

examples.en: There are two yellow parallel lines dividing both sides of traffic.

meaning.en: A phenomenon is something that can be seen as it is happening.

examples.en: I thought the lights were a strange phenomenon, but they were just shooting stars.

meaning.vi: gây ô nhiễm, làm ô nhiễm
meaning.en: To pollute means to make air, water, or land dirty, unclean, or foul.

examples.en: The careless factory polluted the river with chemicals.

meaning.en: To ridicule is to make fun of something in a mean way.

examples.en: The other students ridicule Peter’s foreign accent.

meaning.en: If something is solar, it is related to the sun.

examples.en: Using solar energy is good for the environment.

meaning.vi: lãnh thổ; (US) hạt (vùng chưa được hưởng những quyền lợi như một bang)
meaning.en: A territory is a piece of land that belongs to a country but isn’t a state.

examples.en: Gibraltar is a territory of Great Britain.

meaning.en: A tournament is a competition, usually with many people participating.

examples.en: My dad is playing in a golf tournament tomorrow.

meaning.vi: phương tiện vận tải, sự chuyên chở, sự vận tải
meaning.en: Transportation is any type of vehicle that can carry people or things.

examples.en: I don’t have a car, so my normal transportation is the train.

meaning.vi: (toán kinh tế) ngân phiếu; hoá đơn
meaning.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or for a service.

examples.en: I have so many bills that I do not know how to pay them all.

meaning.en: A boundary is the line where one area of land stops and another begins.

examples.en: This fence shows the boundary between our yard and yours.

meaning.vi: sự lộn xộn, sự hỗn loạn
meaning.en: Chaos is a situation that is confusing and not ordered.

examples.en: His presentation was in chaos. I couldn’t understand what he meant.

meaning.vi: kiên định, trước sau như một
meaning.en: If a person is consistent, they always have the same behavior or attitude.

examples.en: Sara comes in every day and is our most consistent worker.

meaning.en: A cyclone is a large storm with heavy rain and winds that spin in a circle.

examples.en: Hundreds of homes were damaged by the cyclone.

meaning.vi: phải chịu số phận bi đát
meaning.en: If someone or something is doomed, they are going to fail or be destroyed.

examples.en: Since I spent all my money, my date with Jane is doomed.

meaning.vi: người thừa kế, người thừa tự, người kế tục (sự nghiệp)
meaning.en: An heir is a person who receives the money or property of someone who dies.

examples.en: The princess was the heir to the king and queen’s throne.

meaning.vi: thuộc võ, thượng võ; (thuộc) quân sự; (thuộc) chiến tranh
meaning.en: If something is martial, it is related to fighting or war.

examples.en: Karate is a martial art that began many years ago in Japan.

meaning.en: If food is organic, it is grown without adding chemicals to it.

examples.en: The organic carrots are more expensive, but they’re better for you.

meaning.en: Poultry is a bird, such as a chicken, that is used for meat and eggs.

examples.en: He raises poultry and sells their meat for extra money.

meaning.vi: bò, toài, trườn (trên đất mấp mô)
meaning.en: To scramble is to move somewhere quickly and desperately.

examples.en: The hikers scrambled down the side of the hill.

meaning.vi: (quân sự) trung sĩ; hạ sĩ cảnh sát
meaning.en: A sergeant is a soldier or police officer of middle rank.

examples.en: He was promoted to sergeant after a year in the army.

meaning.en: If you describe something as sheer, it is complete and total.

examples.en: I was impressed by her sheer dedication to jogging.

meaning.en: A stance is an attitude about an issue that someone states clearly.

examples.en: My stance is that using oil and gas is bad for the environment.

meaning.vi: đánh điện, gửi điện, máy điện báo
meaning.en: A telegraph is a method of sending electric messages on wires.

examples.en: In the 1900s, the telegraph was the fastest way to send a message.

meaning.en: Textile is cloth that has been woven or knitted.

examples.en: The blue textile was going to be used to make blouses.

meaning.vi: bão táp, cuồng phong. lốc xoáy
meaning.en: A tornado is a tube-shaped formation of air that spins very quickly.

examples.en: During a tornado, the safest place to be is underground.

meaning.en: A typhoon is a large tropical storm that moves in circles.

examples.en: Thousands of people lost electricity after a typhoon hit Australia.

meaning.en: To wail is to show sadness by crying loudly.

examples.en: The baby wailed because it was hungry.

meaning.vi: (bộ sưu tập) quần áo, tủ quần áo
meaning.en: A wardrobe is the collection of all of a person’s clothing.

examples.en: She bought some new clothes to expand her wardrobe.
